variants.promptText:
Create an ultra-realistic Korean beauty lifestyle portrait of a charming young woman in a cozy sunlit room. She has long, silky dark brown wavy hair cascading over her shoulders, flawless porcelain skin, large expressive eyes, naturally defined brows, soft rosy blush, subtle winged eyeliner, and glossy peach-pink lips.

She wears an oversized off-shoulder knitted sweater with brown and cream horizontal stripes, exposing one shoulder for a relaxed feminine look. Stylish black sunglasses rest casually on top of her head. Her expression is warm, confident, and effortlessly beautiful, looking directly at the camera.

Golden-hour sunlight streams through a nearby window, casting soft warm highlights and delicate shadows across her face and hair. The room features pastel pink walls, creating a dreamy romantic atmosphere.
